response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to agentic workflows at re:cinq, but lacks clear evidence of leading multi-agent AI systems at scale in regulated fintech environments, managing teams beyond 10 people, or designing real-time credit/liquidity systems — key requirements for a CTO role in this domain.
strengths: Hands-on experience with agentic workflows and MCP frameworks at re:cinq
Proven ability to build and ship event-driven, distributed systems (e.g., GISCollective, DLang microservices)
Strong engineering culture contributions via testing, CI/CD, and open-source tooling
concerns: No demonstrated experience leading engineering teams from 10 to 30+ in a scale-up fintech context
Lack of visible production experience in financial risk, credit, or compliance-critical AI systems
No evidence of architecting model-agnostic, auditable agent frameworks with feedback loops for trading
